## Teaching Philosophy {#teaching-philosophy}

I teach statistical methods through real research questions and practical decisions. Students learn to understand their data, evaluate modeling choices, check assumptions, and communicate what their findings support.

```{=html}
<div class="ts-framework" aria-label="Six stages of the teaching framework">
  <div class="ts-framework-heading"><strong>How I teach quantitative reasoning</strong><span>From research questions to clear, reproducible conclusions</span></div>
  <div class="ts-framework-steps">
    <div class="ts-framework-step"><span class="ts-step-number">01</span><strong>Question</strong><small>Define the problem</small></div>
    <div class="ts-framework-step"><span class="ts-step-number">02</span><strong>Data</strong><small>Examine structure and measurement</small></div>
    <div class="ts-framework-step"><span class="ts-step-number">03</span><strong>Model</strong><small>Choose an appropriate method</small></div>
    <div class="ts-framework-step"><span class="ts-step-number">04</span><strong>Diagnostics</strong><small>Check assumptions and fit</small></div>
    <div class="ts-framework-step"><span class="ts-step-number">05</span><strong>Interpret</strong><small>Evaluate uncertainty</small></div>
    <div class="ts-framework-step"><span class="ts-step-number">06</span><strong>Communicate</strong><small>Report findings clearly</small></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Teaching Approach

::: {.teaching-approach-grid}
::: {.teaching-approach-card}
<div class="interest-label">01</div>
### Authentic Inquiry
Use real research problems to connect statistical methods with substantive questions.
:::

::: {.teaching-approach-card}
<div class="interest-label">02</div>
### Scaffolding & Feedback
Combine worked examples, annotated code, and feedback to build students’ confidence and judgment.
:::

::: {.teaching-approach-card}
<div class="interest-label">03</div>
### Reproducible Practice
Emphasize transparent code, diagnostic checks, and reporting that others can reproduce.
:::
:::
